privateDiscoveryCredential.scope: Local derivation for the designated configuration repository only. App keys stay local; approvals expire at least 300 seconds before their token. Repeat applies preserve valid owned tokens; superseded tokens expire within one hour.

sourceBinding: Exact same-repository PR SHA and exact source blob digest; platform approval separately binds immutable image and chart revision.
applicationArtifacts: Public immutable artifacts require an approved signer, issuer, source repository and signed githubWorkflowSha equal to the approved source SHA. Private registry credentials are not supported.
identity: Distinct private browser origin, public PKCE client and audience per instance. Exact callback and empty health/callback exceptions; legacy shared origins retire before execution or repair; no production credentials.
deletion: Only inventoried disposable preview objects and clients. UID/version guards and complete namespace inventory precede cascading deletion. Unexpected storage, retention or ownership blocks deletion.
persistentResources: ApplicationSet create-update and resource preservation remain effective. Git failures never authorize persistent application or private-source pruning.
